program.section_heading: PHOTOGRAPHY: AERIAL DRONE PHOTOGRAPHY AND BASIC SPATIAL PHOTOGRAMMETRY Certificate of Completion (Noncredit)
outcomes: Students will be able to perform basic multirotor drone operations, including manual flight, safety procedures, hardware recognition and FAA recreational rules.

Students will be able to demonstrate GPS-enabled flight, aerial photography and cinematic video techniques through creative planning and supervised practice, preparing them for real-world uses in drone careers.

Students will be able to, through comprehensive training in airspace classifications, weather interpretation, mission planning, and autonomous flight control, demonstrate their prepartion for FAA Part 107 certification and legal commercial drone operations.

Students will be able to capture and process aerial and ground imagery for the creation of digital twins, applying photogrammetry to various industries, including construction, public safety and cultural heritage.
